title: PageRequest
description: How a caller asks for a page. Rust: every `limit` parameter of SessionBackend (crates/agentscope-durable/src/session_backend.rs) is validated by backend/mod.rs::clamp_limit, which answers INVALID 'Page limit must be 1..=1000' for 0 or anything above 1000. The same bound applies to journal reads, event reads and resource SEARCH limits (ResourceRequest::validate also caps limit at 1000).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page (event cursors are '<session storage key>:<sequence>'). Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Page size. 1..=1000 inclusive; both ends are hard: 0 and 1001 are rejected, never clamped.
